title: Evidence verification view
description: verification/verdicts.json in an evidence/v1 export: a view derived from records.ndjson that lists the verdict records and the verifier run reports. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; the view equals what DeriveViews produces from the records (entries in chain order; each entry's sequence, ev_id and record_hash name a real record); the file exists only when there is at least one verdict or report; at most 1 MiB.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

verdicts.description: Absent when there are no verdict records.

reports.description: Absent when there are no verifier.run records.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

outputs.description: Absent when the record has no outputs.

ref.description: A reference of at most 1024 bytes with no .. path segment; the length bound and the segment rule are not expressible here.
